items.html: MY Leaders Scholarship Fund: Fostering Young Muslim Leaders in the USA
items.text: MY Leaders Scholarship Fund: Fostering Young Muslim Leaders in the USA

items.html:
MY Project USA aims to give several Leadership Training Scholarship to Muslim youth that are committed to community service, excellent character and civic engagement in the USA.

The recipient of this scholarship will be required to complete 30 community service hours and to launch/join a community service initiative. 

We are open to have several scholarships under different family names. If you are interested to have one under your parents name or family name, we can definitely do so. We will include you in the process of selecting the recipient of your scholarship. Minimum donation amount for such family scholarship would be $500. In general, any amount will help though. 

 

You can contribute toward this fund through general donations or zakat. You can opt to pay one-time or through recurring payments.

 

Questions: info@myprojectusa.org or 614-905-0977.

items.html:
MY Zakat Power: 10 Ways to Make an Impact 

 

At MY Project USA, we are striving to help our youth and families with financial challenges. We are working on both short-term and long-term goals.

 

Although every aspect of our work falls into at least one category of zakat eligibility, the funds collected on this page will be used exclusively to empower those who are eligible to receive zakat and sadaqas - homeless/needy brothers and sisters from various ethnic, racial and faith group.

Help Us save lives and families while raising responsible citizens, community leaders, peace advocates, public servants and story tellers to secure Islam’s legacy in America for generations to come. 

 

We need an estimated amount of $200,000 this year. 

 

As we are in our first year, by giving your money now, you could become among the "Sabiqoon al awwaloon,"  the First and foremost in protecting, nurturing and empowering Muslim American youth. Each one of these youth will then become Sadaqa-e-jariyah, the ongoing charity for you.
